mapper.insert:
insert into diaries
user_id, status, version, version_group, is_current, source_type, content, diary_date, emotions, emotion_score, confirmed_at,
values
#{userId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{versionGroup}, #{isCurrent}, #{sourceType}, #{content}, #{diaryDate}, #{emotions}, #{emotionScore}, #{confirmedAt},
mapper.update:
UPDATE diaries
diary_date = #{diaryDate},
source_type = #{sourceType},
emotions = #{emotions, typeHandler=com.yanglizi.common.handler.ArrayTypeHandler},
emotion_score = #{emotionScore},
content = #{content},
version_group = #{versionGroup},
version = #{version},
is_current = #{isCurrent},
confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt},
deleted_at = #{deletedAt},
status = #{status},
updated_at = now()
WHERE id = #{id}
update diaries set is_current = 0 where user_id = #{userId} and version_group = #{versionGroup} and is_current = 1
mapper.select: select id, user_id, diary_date, source_type, emotions, emotion_score, content, version_group, version, is_current, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, status from diaries where id = #{id}

SELECT id, content, user_id AS userId, emotion_score AS emotionScore, paradedb.score(id) AS score FROM diaries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_current = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 AND content @@@ #{query} ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, diary_date, source_type, emotions, emotion_score, content, version_group, version, is_current, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, status FROM diaries WHERE delete_at is null AND id IN
#{id}

SELECT id, diary_date, source_type, emotions, emotion_score, content, version_group, version, is_current, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, status FROM diaries WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at is null

SELECT id, user_id, diary_date, source_type, emotion_score, version_group, version, is_current, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, status FROM diaries WHERE version_group = #{versionGroup} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at is null ORDER BY version DESC

SELECT a.id, a.diary_date, a.source_type, a.emotions, a.emotion_score, a.version_group, a.version, a.is_current, a.confirmed_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.status, b.title FROM diaries a join chat_sessions b on a.version_group = b.version_group where a.user_id = #{userId} and a.is_current = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.diary_date, a.source_type, a.emotions, a.emotion_score, a.version_group, a.version, a.is_current, a.confirmed_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.status, b.title FROM diaries a join chat_sessions b on a.version_group = b.version_group where a.user_id = #{userId} and a.status = #{status} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT status FROM diaries WHERE id = #{id} AND version_group = #{versionGroup} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at is null
